entry.title: Choosing when the music plays
entry.summary: Junnifa describes her babies choosing to start and pause music with a reachable player button. It is a personal example of choice, alongside the authors’ preference for quiet between musical moments.
entry.cue: Your baby is interested in starting or stopping a familiar sound.
detail: When her babies were around 8 or 9 months, Junnifa marked the play button of a small CD player. They could approach it and later press the same button to pause.
This is one family’s example, not a needed purchase. The authors also share music through singing and listening together.
